title: Product Manager
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

PTC is seeking a **Principal Product Manager** to join our Visualization Product Management team and lead the products and technologies that transform complex engineering data into visualization-ready content across PTC’s product portfolio.

You will have primary product responsibility for **Visualization Content Services (VCS), Windchill Visualization Services (WVS), and Product View Adapters** , working at the intersection of **CAD interoperability, enterprise PLM, visualization, and content processing** .

This is a hands-on product leadership role for a technically oriented PM who enjoys solving complex engineering problems, working closely with engineers and architects, and engaging directly with customers and partners worldwide.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the product direction, priorities, roadmap, requirements, releases, and adoption of **VCS, WVS, and Product View Adapters** .
* Drive the evolution of **VCS into a broader content-processing platform** supporting reusable publishing, transformation, and processing services across PTC products.
* Lead product direction for **Windchill publishing** , including publishing workflows, representations, reliability, scalability, serviceability, security, storage, and performance.
* Define **CAD interoperability and Product View Adapter strategy** across native CAD formats, neutral formats, adapters, third-party conversion technologies, and emerging interoperability requirements.
* Work directly with global **customers and partners** to translate publishing, CAD conversion, deployment, and operational challenges into scalable product capabilities.
* Partner with engineering and architecture on complex technical decisions involving conversion technologies, distributed processing, cloud services, deployment architecture, performance, licensing, and build-versus-buy choices.
* Balance near-term customer and release priorities with longer-term investments in architecture, scalability, interoperability, and platform evolution.
* Mentor other Product Managers and provide technical and product leadership across the Visualization PM team.

**What You Bring**

* Strong Product Management experience with technically complex enterprise software, engineering applications, platforms, or infrastructure.
* **Deep working knowledge of Windchill publishing is required** , including WVS, publishing workflows, representations, workers/adapters, and downstream visualization.
* **Demonstrated CAD interoperability expertise is required** , including CAD translation, native and neutral formats, adapters, and conversion technologies.
* Strong understanding of **CAD, PLM, and engineering workflows** .
* Ability to work deeply with engineering and architecture teams while connecting technical decisions to customer and business value.
* Experience engaging directly with customers and turning complex technical problems into scalable product capabilities.
* Strong cross-functional leadership, communication, and influencing skills in a globally distributed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+years of experience as a **software engineer, architect, solution architect, technical consultant, or similar technical role** involving CAD, PLM, visualization, or engineering software.
* Broader knowledge of Windchill and enterprise PLM processes.
* Experience with **cloud/SaaS architectures, distributed processing, or content-processing platforms** .
* Experience with interoperability SDKs, third-party conversion technologies, neutral formats, or **USD/OpenUSD** .

  

**How You’ll Lead**

This is a senior **individual-contributor role** without direct people-management responsibility. You will lead through product expertise, technical credibility, collaboration, and influence across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, customers, and partners.

The position is **based in India with global responsibilities** . International travel is required based on customer, partner, and business needs.

**Your mission: Own the product leadership and future direction of PTC’s visualization publishing, content-processing, and interoperability platform across VCS, WVS, and Product View Adapters.**

  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

title: S2B Product Manager, Statements & Reporting, Digital Channel Solutions
description:
Requisition Number: 66516

Global Grade: Band 5

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for corporate client Statements, Advice and Transactional Reporting across S2B Web, Host-to-Host, SWIFT and API channels.

• Develop a coherent omnichannel reporting experience that enables clients to discover, configure, receive, download and reconcile account information consistently, regardless of the channel used.
  
• Drive convergence of reporting journeys, data definitions, formats, entitlements and service standards across channels, while accommodating channel-specific client needs and integration models.
  
• Translate client, business, regulatory and servicing needs into secure, resilient and scalable prior-day and intraday reporting capabilities, using client usage analytics to improve adoption, simplify the estate and guide lifecycle decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Product Strategy, Vision and Roadmap**  
• Define and maintain the global product vision, target-state architecture principles and multi-year roadmap for statements, account reporting, transaction reporting and advices across digital channels.
  
• Prioritise investments using client value, adoption, revenue enablement, regulatory obligations, service risk, architecture health and total cost of ownership; develop business cases and measurable outcomes.
  
• Benchmark market capabilities and emerging standards, converting insights into differentiated propositions and sequenced capability increments.

**Client Reporting Proposition and Standards**  
• Own the catalogue of prior-day and intraday statements, debit/credit advices, balance and transaction reports, including channel availability, eligibility, formats, service levels and client-facing documentation.
  
• Guide support for relevant reporting standards and formats, including SWIFT MT940/MT942, ISO 20022 camt.052/camt.053/camt.054, BAI2, CSV, PDF, XML and API payloads, with clear versioning and migration plans.
  
• Ensure consistent semantics, reconciliation behaviour, balances, value dates, transaction codes, references and data lineage across Web, H2H, SWIFT and API delivery.
  
**End-to-End Product Ownership and Agile Delivery**  
• Convert strategy and client needs into epics, capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements; own backlog ordering and make transparent scope and trade-off decisions.
  
• Lead discovery, solution shaping, design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations, UAT, release readiness, production rollout and benefits validation with Technology, Architecture, Operations and servicing teams.
  
• Embed security, privacy, entitlement, auditability, accessibility, performance, availability, scalability and observability requirements from inception.

**Client Experience, Adoption and Commercialisation**  
**• Use research, servicing insights and journey mapping to simplify report discovery, subscription, configuration, scheduling, delivery, download and exception handling.**  
**• Partner with Sales, Implementation, Client Service and country/cluster teams on client propositions, complex solutioning, migration, launch communications, training and adoption campaigns.**  
**• Define and monitor success measures such as active clients, report delivery and download utilisation, migration progress, digital adoption, service availability, failure rates, latency and client feedback.**

**Data, Architecture and Service Resilience**  
**• Maintain an accurate current-state view of source systems, data flows, transformation rules, interfaces, loaders, schedulers and upstream/downstream dependencies, including ownership and service levels.**  
**• Drive convergence toward reusable data services and a common reporting architecture across Cash and, where relevant, Trade and FSS, reducing duplication and inconsistent client outcomes.**  
**• Own product response to incidents and recurring defects, ensuring root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resilience improvements and prioritisation of technical debt and single points of failure.**

**Risk, Governance and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Operate product governance across new capabilities, material changes and report retirement, including approvals, client impact assessment, migration, records retention, regulatory and compliance review, and operational readiness.**  
**• Maintain product standards, controls, risks, dependencies, decision records and audit evidence; ensure issues are escalated and remediated with clear ownership and closure criteria.**  
**• Use usage and cost analysis to identify reports for growth, consolidation or decommissioning, validating recommendations with product, country, technology, operations and client stakeholders.**

**Stakeholder Leadership and Decision Making**  
**• Act as the accountable product subject-matter expert, aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, Implementation and Client Service.**  
**• Communicate complex data and technology topics clearly to executive and delivery audiences; facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities and maintain momentum across globally distributed teams.**  
**• This is an individual-contributor Product Owner role with matrix leadership responsibility across multidisciplinary delivery teams and strategic partners.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Digital Product Strategy and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Transaction Banking Statements and Reporting**  
**• Agile Product Ownership and Backlog Management**  
**• Data Architecture, Integration and ISO 20022/SWIFT Standards**  
**• Risk, Controls and Operational Resilience**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Client Experience, Commercialisation and Adoption**  
**• Data Analytics and Product Performance Management**  
**• Stakeholder Management and Executive Communication**  
**• Service Management, Incident and Problem Management**  
**• Market and Competitive Analysis**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Solving complex client reporting and reconciliation challenges**

**• Driven to ensure data integrity and consistency across channels and transaction types, with aligned definitions, mappings, balances, references and reconciliation outcomes that clients can trust.**  
**• Building a coherent omnichannel experience across S2B Web, H2H, SWIFT and API**  
**• Leading collaboratively in regulated, globally distributed environments**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in transaction banking, cash management, corporate digital channels, data/reporting products or complex banking technology delivery.**  
**• Demonstrated Product Owner or Product Manager experience owning strategy, roadmap, backlog and end-to-end delivery for enterprise digital products.**  
**• Strong domain experience in corporate account information, statements, transaction reporting, advices or cash-management reporting across Web, H2H, SWIFT and/or API channels.**  
**• Practical experience with SWIFT account reporting and ISO 20022 cash-management messages; familiarity with MT940/942 and camt.052/053/054 is strongly preferred.**  
**• Experience translating data flows, source-to-target mappings, reconciliation rules and complex integrations into product requirements and client outcomes.**  
**• Track record of leading cross-functional delivery, UAT, releases, migrations, production incident remediation and lifecycle rationalisation in a regulated environment.**  
**• Strong analytical capability using product telemetry and client usage data; working knowledge of SQL, Power BI or Tableau is advantageous.**  
**• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and globally distributed teams without direct authority.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory)**  
**• Degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.**  
**• Product Owner, Agile or Scrum certification is advantageous, not mandatory.**  
**• SWIFT, ISO 20022, cash-management or data-management training/certification is advantageous.**  
**Languages**  
**• Professional fluency in English; additional market languages are advantageous where relevant to the role scope.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Overview:

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

We need a candidate who sits with an ERP SME or business user, understand the business process; inspect the underlying data/schema; define the business entities/KPIs; map source concepts to the semantic model; write requirements detailed enough for Engineering; validate the implementation (reports, AI query, or Agent outputs) with SMEs/customers.

**Knowledge:**

Requires strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts, including relational data models, business entities and relationships, semantic modeling, analytical metrics/KPIs, and data transformation from operational systems into analytics-ready structures.

Requires the ability to understand business processes and reporting requirements and translate them into detailed data and semantic-model definitions. You must be comfortable analyzing source schemas, tables, fields, relationships, and existing reporting assets in partnership with Engineering and domain experts.

Requires working knowledge of product management and business analysis practices, including requirements definition, customer and SME discovery, prioritization, documentation, validation, and cross-functional product development.

Knowledge of enterprise software, ERP systems, modern cloud data platforms, BI tools, and AI-enabled analytics is preferred.

**Complexity:**

Works across multiple business domains, ERP/product schemas, and analytics use cases where business terminology, source data structures, and customer requirements may differ.

Translates sometimes ambiguous business questions and existing reporting requirements into standardized entities, measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and semantic definitions that can be reused across products and customers.

Balances standard product requirements against ERP-specific and customer-specific requirements and identifies where extensions to the governed model are required.

Works through dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, domain SMEs, Professional Services, customers, and other stakeholders to move semantic-model and Analytics Package work from discovery through validation.

This reflects the actual scope in the resourcing case: reusable semantic models are intended to span Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, Quality and other domains, with iteration occurring across ERPs and eventually non-Aptean systems.

**Supervision:**

Works with a high degree of independence within defined product priorities and objectives.

Receives strategic direction from the Director, Product Management – Analytics & Data Products and independently drives assigned semantic-model domains and Analytics Package workstreams.

Coordinates work across technical and business stakeholders but does not initially have direct people-management responsibility.

Escalates significant product, data, architecture, and prioritization decisions where broader alignment is required.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Define business semantics and domain models.
* Lead discovery with product SMEs, customers, and internal stakeholders to understand business processes, entities, relationships, terminology, business questions, metrics, and KPIs. Translate these inputs into detailed, reusable semantic-model requirements and domain definitions.
* Analyze source data and define source-to-semantic mappings.
* Work with Product and Data Engineering teams to understand existing products and ERP schemas, including relevant tables, fields, keys, relationships, and business logic. Define and document how source data maps to standardized business entities, dimensions, measures, and relationships within the semantic model, and identify gaps requiring transformation or extension.
* Define Analytics Packages
* Translate business questions, KPIs, reporting requirements, and semantic-model capabilities into reusable Analytics Packages across functional domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Inventory, and Quality. Define package requirements, measures, dimensions, reporting experiences, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.
* Driving semantic-model requirements through Engineering
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Architecture to convert product requirements into implementable semantic-model capabilities. Clarify requirements, resolve data and business-rule questions, review model implementations against intended business semantics, identify gaps, and support prioritization through delivery.
* Validate models and packages with customers and SMEs
* Plan and conduct validation sessions with domain SMEs, customers, and implementation teams to confirm that semantic definitions, KPIs, business rules, and Analytics Packages accurately represent real-world processes and reporting needs. Convert validation findings into prioritized product requirements and model improvements.
* Standardize capabilities across products and customers
* Compare requirements and source structures across ERP products and customer environments to distinguish reusable business concepts from product- or customer-specific requirements. Help establish canonical definitions while identifying where governed extensions are necessary.
* Maintain product artifacts and semantic-model documentation
* Create and maintain clear product artifacts including business definitions, entity and relationship definitions, KPI specifications, source mappings, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, Analytics Package specifications, and supporting documentation required by Engineering and downstream product teams.
* Support analytics and AI product evolution
* Use customer feedback, product usage, implementation learning, and emerging requirements to identify opportunities to improve semantic models and Analytics Packages. Support the evolution of the semantic layer as a governed business context for analytics, natural-language analytics, Analytics Agents, and broader AI and Decision Intelligence capabilities.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree, Preferred fields**:** Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative/technical discipline.
* Master's degree: A Master's degree in a relevant technical, analytics, or business discipline is preferred but not required.

**Shift**: UK Shift

**Recommended:** 12+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis, data/analytics, enterprise software, or a related discipline.

Experience should include meaningful hands-on work translating business requirements into data, analytics, reporting, or semantic-model requirements.

Experience working with enterprise applications, ERP data, analytics products, data platforms, or complex relational data environments is strongly preferred.

Experience collaborating directly with software/data engineering teams and business/domain stakeholders through discovery, requirements definition, implementation, and validation is strongly preferred.

**Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of relational data concepts, including tables, keys, joins, relationships, normalization, and dimensional/analytical modeling.
* Understanding of semantic modeling, including business entities, dimensions, measures, metrics, hierarchies, relationships, and business definitions.
* Understanding of how operational application data is transformed and modeled for analytics and reporting.
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts, including KPIs, dashboards, reporting, data quality, and analytical requirements.
* Understanding of product-management and business-analysis practices including discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and validation.
* Familiarity with enterprise/ERP business processes such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, or related domains.
* Familiarity with modern cloud data and analytics platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, natural-language analytics, or semantic layers supporting AI applications is beneficial.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong SQL and data-analysis capability, with the ability to independently explore relational datasets and understand source schemas, relationships, and business logic.
* Ability to translate business processes and questions into entities, relationships, dimensions, measures, KPIs, and semantic definitions**.**
* Ability to analyze existing reports, dashboards, queries, and data structures to reverse-engineer underlying business requirements.
* Ability to work with Data Engineering to define and validate source-to-semantic data mappings.
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous or incomplete requirements.
* Strong product and requirements-management skills, including writing clear requirements, acceptance criteria, specifications, and product documentation.
* Ability to facilitate structured discovery with customers, SMEs, Product teams, and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to distinguish standard/reusable product requirements from customer-specific requirements and recommend appropriate model extensions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data concepts to business stakeholders and business concepts to technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and drive work to measurable outcomes across distributed global teams.
* High attention to detail, particularly when defining metrics, business rules, data mappings, and semantic definitions.
* Ability to work in China, India, North America (EST) time zones as needed. Should be flexible as per the requirements of business

**What’s in it for you?**  
Aptean offers competitive pay and robust benefit plans along with the opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced, flexible and casual environment, an outstanding opportunity for career development and growth.

**About Aptean**

At Aptean, our mission is to solve tomorrow’s unique challenges today with unrivaled, purpose-built software and superior customer experiences from people who care. Aptean is a global provider of mission-critical, industry-specific software solutions.  
Aptean’ s purpose-built ERP and supply chain management solutions help address the unique challenges facing process and discrete manufacturers, distributors and other focused organizations. Aptean’ s compliance solutions are built for companies serving  
specific markets such as finance, healthcare, biotech and pharmaceuticals, over 10,000 highly specialized organizations in more than 20 industries and 80 countries rely on Aptean to streamline their everyday operations.

“At Aptean, our global and diverse employee base is our greatest asset. It is through embracing and understanding our differences that we are able to harness our individual power to maximize the success of our customers, our employees and our company. –  
TVN Reddy

Aptean pledges to promote a company culture where diversity, equity and inclusion are central. We are committed to applying this principle as we interact with our customers, build our teams, cultivate our leaders and shape a company in which any employee can  
succeed, regardless of race, color, sex, national origin, sexuality and gender identity, religion, disability or age. Celebrating our diverse experiences, opinions and beliefs allows us to embrace what makes us unique and to use this as an asset in bringing  
innovative solutions to our customer base.

* 2 years of experience taking technical products from concept to launch.

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. description:
Location:

Chennai, India

Business:

Energy Systems

Position type:

Full Time

Contract type:

Permanent Employee

8074

  

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About Energy Systems**

  
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

### **About the role**

**Job Description**

The Product Manager - AI Workflows is a customer-facing product role within the Product organization, reporting to the Head of Section - AI Solutions. This role connects DNV's technical experts with the AI products built for them, turning advisory, verification and technical due-diligence workflows across the energy value chain into AI-enabled capabilities that support the Transformational Trust Initiative across Energy Systems.

This role is accountable for adoption and measurable value, not only delivery. The Product Manager brings service lines onto the platform, proves value on live project work with a first customer, and tracks time saved, output quality and sustained use after launch.

This role sits within Digital & Transformation and works outward with service-line leaders, regional teams, Global Service Area Leads and senior subject matter experts (SMEs), with an initial focus on oil and gas, pipelines and offshore structures. The Product Manager breaks each workflow into steps and routes each step to the right team. Document-based work that AI can perform reliably becomes an AI workflow; engineering calculations, modelling, drawing interpretation and site activity go to the teams that own calculation, data and analytics capabilities.[SF1] [RG2]

This position collaborates directly with the Head of Section - AI Solutions to qualify AI opportunities, shape the roadmap, run discovery and pilots, and scale proven workflows across regions and service lines. The role works across time zones with teams in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Latin America and Asia Pacific.

This role is based at our Chennai, India office, with travel to other regions (up to 15% of the time).

**What you’ll do**

**Business Engagement & Opportunity Qualification**

* Act as the lead product partner for assigned service lines and regions across Advisory, Verification and Technical Due Diligence.
* Build trusted working relationships with service-line leaders, Global Service Area Leads and senior SMEs, and learn how their work is scoped, delivered and quality-checked.
* Break each workflow into steps and triage them: document review, extraction, compliance checks and drafting that AI can perform reliably, versus engineering calculations, modelling and simulation, drawing interpretation, financial models and site activity that need calculation tools, specialist software or an expert on site. Route each step to the team that owns it.
* Qualify and prioritize opportunities on volume of work, hours per task, error risk, customer value and feasibility, and capture a baseline before any build starts.

**Company:** iFieldSmart Technologies LLC

**Position:** Product Manager

**Experience:** Experienced professional with a B2B SaaS background

**1. Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and execution-oriented Product Manager who will act as a central coordination point between the Sales, Marketing, Product Coordination, and Product Development functions.

The primary responsibility of this role is to take end-to-end ownership of product delivery commitments made to clients by the Sales team and ensure that products currently under development are completed, made market-ready, and successfully handed over to the Marketing team for launch.

The individual will work closely with our existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, who are responsible for managing individual products and development programs and coordinating with engineering management and development teams.

The new Product Manager will oversee and coordinate across these program owners, track overall progress, ensure alignment on priorities and deadlines, proactively identify bottlenecks, and take ownership of ensuring that business commitments are fulfilled.

This is a highly coordination-driven and ownership-oriented role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, work with cross-functional teams, proactively identify challenges, and drive timely execution.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Client-Specific Product Delivery Management**

· Take complete ownership of product delivery commitments made by the Sales team to different clients.

· Coordinate with the respective Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers responsible for the development of those products or features.

· Ensure that client-specific requirements, priorities, and committed delivery timelines are clearly communicated to the respective program owners.

· Maintain proactive tracking of multiple ongoing client deliveries, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines across different programs.

· Regularly follow up with the respective coordinators and program managers to understand development progress and identify potential delays or roadblocks.

· Proactively identify risks, resolve coordination bottlenecks, and escalate critical issues to senior management whenever required.

· Maintain clear communication and alignment between Sales, Marketing, and Product/Program Management teams regarding delivery status, changes, and expectations.

· Ensure that client commitments are not just tracked but successfully fulfilled, taking full accountability for overall delivery outcomes.

**B. Product Completion & Market Launch Management**

· Take ownership of existing products and features that are in the development or finalization stage.

· Work closely with the respective Product Coordinators and Program Managers to ensure pending development activities are completed.

· Track product readiness, identify gaps, and drive closure of pending requirements before launch.

· Coordinate with the concerned program owners to ensure product testing, quality checks, and final readiness activities are completed.

· Ensure completed products and features are properly documented and handed over to the Marketing team.

· Work closely with Marketing to communicate product capabilities, features, use cases, and launch requirements.

· Ensure products are ready for marketing campaigns, customer demonstrations, and commercial rollout.

· Track the overall product launch pipeline and ensure products do not remain indefinitely in the development or finalization stage.

**C. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

· Act as the central coordination point between Sales, Marketing, and the existing Product Coordination / Program Management teams.

· Work closely with multiple Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, each responsible for managing different products or development programs.

· Maintain visibility into the progress of all ongoing product development initiatives and client-specific commitments.

· Ensure business priorities, client requirements, and deadlines are aligned with the respective program owners.

· Conduct regular follow-ups and status reviews to ensure timely execution.

· Proactively identify dependencies, delays, resource constraints, and risks that could impact product delivery.

· Coordinate with the relevant program owners to resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to senior management, engineering management, or the CEO whenever necessary.

· Keep senior management informed about delivery progress, critical dependencies, risks, and challenges.

· Ensure smooth information flow between technical and non-technical teams.

**Important clarification about the role:** The Product Manager will primarily coordinate with the existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers rather than directly managing developers or assigning day-to-day technical development tasks. The respective program owners will continue to manage development execution through engineering management and development teams. However, the new Product Manager will be accountable for tracking and driving overall delivery outcomes.

**3. Candidate Profile & Required Experience**

We are specifically looking for someone with:

· Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

· Exposure to international markets and experience working with international clients or customers, preferably the US market.

· Previous experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.

· Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, particularly Sales, Product, Program Management, and Engineering functions.

· Experience in product delivery management, program coordination, product operations, or product management.

· Strong project execution, delivery management, and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, client commitments, products, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Experience tracking deliverables through multiple project or program owners.

· A proactive approach to identifying problems, following up, and ensuring things get completed.

**4. Preferred Mindset & Additional Requirements**

· Flexible and adaptable to a fast-paced startup environment.

· Willingness to multitask and take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

· Strong execution-oriented mindset rather than just planning and reporting.

· Ability and willingness to learn the technical aspects of AI-powered products and solutions.

· Willingness to understand the construction technology industry and its workflows.

· Good communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Ability to work independently, drive accountability, and ensure follow-through without requiring constant supervision.

**5. What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should be able to ensure that:

1. Whatever Sales commits to clients gets delivered within the agreed timelines.

2. All existing Product Coordinators and Program Managers are aligned with business priorities and client delivery commitments.

3. The overall progress of multiple products and development programs is proactively tracked.

4. Potential delivery issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks are identified and addressed before they become major problems.

5. Senior management has clear visibility into product delivery progress and potential risks.

6. Products nearing completion are driven towards launch readiness.

7. Marketing receives completed, properly documented products and features for successful market launches.

8. There is clear coordination and accountability between all business and product-related teams.

**The ideal candidate is an execution-focused Product Manager who can connect business commitments with internal product execution, coordinate multiple program owners, and take complete ownership of getting things delivered.**

* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.

* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 3+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. The product team is organized by capability, not segment. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager, alongside Customer Experience Core (campaign creation, onboarding and activation).  
  
**About the role:**  
You will build Accelerate's payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

**What you will own:**

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
* Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
* Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
* Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
* Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
* Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
* Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate's success framework depends on your system.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
* You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
* Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
* Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.  
  Strong pluses
* You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
* Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
* Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
* Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
* Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.

title: Senior AI Product Manager
description:
**Job Purpose:**

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

  

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

title: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications and data-driven solutions that power the financial services industry. We help businesses improve operational efficiency, enhance client experiences and make better decisions through innovative technology and data solutions.

At Broadridge, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built around collaboration, innovation, accountability and continuous learning, where employees have the opportunity to work on meaningful, business-critical solutions and build long-term careers.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The **Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics** owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

The role also focuses on monitoring, issue resolution, process standardization, data governance, and stakeholder communication, while guiding Level 1 resources and working closely with Level 2/3 IT support teams to drive long-term stability and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead product discovery by gathering requirements from stakeholders, users, and technical teams.
* Design, implement, and govern data quality controls, reconciliation frameworks, and exception management mechanisms.
* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products aligned with business goals.
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, and strategic fit.
* Identify high-impact opportunities where data products can improve decision-making, operations, or customer experience.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business leaders to deliver data products.
* Drive implementation of data products in data platforms, dashboards, semantic layers, self-service analytics tools, APIs, and ML-enabled solutions.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure adoption, usability, data quality, and business impact.
* Champion data quality, governance, documentation, and trust across products.
* Ensure data products are intuitive, accessible, and fit for purpose for target users.
* Manage stakeholder communication, expectations, timelines and risks.
* Continuously improve products through feedback, usage insights, and performance measurement.
* Support data ownership, governance frameworks, privacy, and compliance requirements where applicable.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

* 7–10+ years of experience in data product management, data, analytics, or platform delivery.
* Extensive hands-on and architectural experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms handling high-volume, business-critical Finance data.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics workflows, and reporting ecosystems.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with data governance, metrics design, and data quality principles.
* Experience delivering internal or external data-driven products.
* Advanced proficiency in **SQL and Snowflake**, including performance tuning, complex validations, reconciliation logic, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with data warehousing, ETL frameworks, and cloud data platforms.
* Preferred understanding of enterprise Finance systems and ERP platforms such as **Oracle (EBS / Fusion)** and **SAP (ECC / S/4HANA)**.
* Proven experience working with workload scheduling and automation tools such as **Apache Airflow and Control-M**.
* Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, controls, and reconciliation frameworks in Finance environments.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
* Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
* Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

* **Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions:** Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
* **Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology:** Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
* **Drive transformation:** Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
* **Collaborative environment:** Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
* **Growth & learning:** Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
* **Global exposure:** Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
* **Innovation-driven culture:** Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

**Join Us**
-----------

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.**

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
